  "summary": "The function fn_09 computes a hash value based on the input buffer using a polynomial multiplication and XOR operation. It does not modify the input buffer and does not write to the output buffer. The function returns the computed hash value or VERA_ERR if the input length is zero.",

  "algorithm": "MurmurHash3",

  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_09(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h ^= in[i];\n    h *= 0x100000001b5;\n  }\n  return h;\n}"
